_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Information Assurance (IA) Test Report
summary: The IA Test Report is used by the government to manage Information Assurance testing that results in accreditation of the ship based information technology system.
use_relationship:
The IA Test Report will be used by the government to manage Information Assurance testing that will result in accreditation of the ship based information technology system to comply with Information Assurance policies and criteria.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data resulting from the work task specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The IA Test Report shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall address the following sections:

children.title: A description of the system/subsystem being tested.
Threat Model for System Under Test
Internal and External IA Threat Exploits
Mitigations by Design, Inheritance or Procedure
Bill of Materials for Security Testing Boundary
Indicated Network topology with Test Points
Master Network Connection Report (MNCR) for Security Testing Boundary
Identify the applicable DISA approved Test Tools
Assumptions regarding test procedures, test conditions and test environment
Test Point Matrix which shall identify:
If Test Tool is installed on machine under test
A justification for chosen Test Point and Test Tool
Personnel Responsibility Matrix shall identify names, official job titles, and functions and responsibilities.
Lead Person for Test Event Activity
The risks and threat levels of the existing security implementations
Deviations from the IA Test Plan with Rationale
Network discovery procedures via automated tools
Operating System discovery procedures via automated tools
Discovering ports, protocols and services via automated tools
Testing done manually in accordance with the applicable Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) used.
Justification for any false positives and the following:
Title of STIG Reference including STIG Version
Applicable IA Controls specified in DoDI 8500.2
Rationale why compliance is not met
Severity Risk Rating (Cat I, II, III)

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement.
preparation_instructions.content: The electronic media for the IA test report shall be Microsoft Office Word Version 2003-2007.
